source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 12ης Αυγούστου — «Όσιος Παλάμων»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 12 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and it is the same man: «Ο Όσιος Παλάμων ήταν γέροντας και σοφός διδάσκαλος του μεγάλου Παχωμίου (τιμάται 15 Μάιου ) και απεβίωσε ειρηνικά» — the elder and wise teacher of Pachomius the Great, who reposed in peace. The page gives no year, no place and no hymn of any kind, so no `dates` object is proposed. It names Pachomius, whom the corpus keeps as `pachomius-the-great`, so the added paragraph links him and a `related_add` row goes with the link. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
